q: Nova City is built on Mars. What protects it from the planet's harsh environment?
options: Sealed tunnels beneath the surface
Thick artificial clouds above the city
A magnetic shield around the planet
Giant glass domes around the city
explain: Nova City sits on Mars, the Red Planet, and is protected from the harsh environment by giant glass domes.

q: What gives Nova City its Earth-like, breathtaking view?
options: A real ocean stretching beyond the domes
Green forests covering the Martian mountains
An artificial blue sky above red mountains
A bright ring of mirrors around the planet
explain: The city is surrounded by red mountains and vast deserts, while an artificial blue sky creates an Earth-like landscape.

q: Robot assistants, smart apartments and rooftop gardens in tall skyscrapers belong to which zone?
options: Spaceport Zone, with landing pads and towers
Entertainment Zone, with cinemas and parks
Residential Zone, with homes and rooftop gardens
Technology Zone, with labs and AI centers
explain: The Residential Zone has tall skyscrapers, smart apartments, rooftop gardens and robot assistants.

q: Where would you find VR cinemas, high-tech amusement parks and automated restaurants?
options: Technology Zone, with research labs and smart buildings
Green Zone, with farms, lakes and artificial forests
Entertainment Zone, with cinemas and automated restaurants
Residential Zone, with apartments and rooftop gardens
explain: The Entertainment Zone offers giant shopping malls, VR cinemas, high-tech amusement parks and automated restaurants.

q: Which zone is home to intelligent buildings, AI research centers and advanced laboratories?
options: Residential Zone, with homes and rooftop gardens
Entertainment Zone, with cinemas and amusement parks
Spaceport Zone, with spacecraft pads and control towers
Technology Zone, with AI centers and advanced labs
explain: Intelligent buildings, AI research centers and advanced laboratories make up the Technology Zone.

q: Which zone grows fresh food on farms and also has artificial forests, lakes and waterfalls?
options: Green Zone, with farms, forests, lakes and waterfalls
Residential Zone, with apartments and robot assistants
Technology Zone, with AI research and advanced labs
Spaceport Zone, with landing pads and control towers
explain: The Green Zone combines artificial forests, lakes, waterfalls and fresh food farms.

q: Which energy combination gives Nova City clean, reliable electricity?
options: Geothermal vents connected to gas pipelines
Solar panels paired with advanced battery storage
Diesel generators combined with wood-burning fires
Coal plants supported by large fuel imports
explain: Solar panels and advanced batteries provide clean and reliable electricity.

q: What does each dome have to keep its air breathable and comfortable?
options: One shared oxygen tank for the entire city
Weekly oxygen deliveries from Earth by cargo ships
Open vents that filter Martian air through plants
Independent oxygen, air purification and temperature control
explain: Every dome has its own independent oxygen supply, air purification and temperature control.

q: Which transport is listed for ultra-fast daily commutes between city zones?
options: Flying taxis for short trips across the city
Underground subways for daily travel across the city
Hyperloops for fast trips between city zones
Rocket shuttles for everyday trips between zones
explain: Hyperloops give ultra-fast daily commutes between zones. Inside the domes, smart transit also includes self-driving cars and flying taxis.

q: About how many citizens will live in Nova City?
options: Around 10 to 15 million people
Around 100 to 150 million people
Around 1 to 1.5 million people
Around 100,000 to 150,000 people
explain: Nova City is a busy, lively city with about 10 to 15 million citizens, including scientists and families.

q: Why does Nova City build so many giant skyscrapers?
options: Each tall building gives every home a landing pad
Skyscrapers are the only buildings able to hold oxygen
Tall buildings save space and protect Mars outside
Tall towers stop every dust storm from reaching the domes
explain: Living in tall buildings helps save space and keeps the natural Mars environment outside safe.

q: How does moving millions of people to Mars help Earth?
options: Sending all Earth's waste to Mars helps the planet recover
Fewer crowds and lower resource use help Earth recover
Fresh water from Martian rivers can supply the Earth
Earth can stop using clean energy once people move
explain: Moving people to Mars reduces crowds and resource use on Earth, giving our home planet time to recover.

q: Why is building a huge city on a dry planet so challenging?
options: Martian gravity is too strong for tall buildings
Too few people are willing to move to another planet
Natural forests must be cleared before building begins
It needs huge amounts of energy and a balanced environment
explain: The poster names the huge energy demand and the need for a perfectly balanced environment as the main challenge.

q: Which of these is NOT a vacation destination mentioned in the poster?
options: Orbiting Space Hotels, included among the destinations
The Moon, one of the destinations listed in the poster
The cloud cities of Venus, which the poster never mentions
Earth, one of the destinations listed in the poster
explain: The poster lists vacations to Earth, the Moon and orbiting Space Hotels. Venus is not mentioned.

q: How do robots help families in Nova City's smart houses?
options: They cook meals only for visitors staying in the house
They guard every front door throughout the night
They clean and do housework, giving families more free time
They teach all children instead of sending them to school
explain: Robots help clean and do housework, which saves time for families.

q: Which description fits a Nova City green building?
options: Windowless towers with sealed air and artificial lighting
Rooftop gardens, natural light, solar panels and water-saving systems
Underground bunkers powered by diesel generators
Open-air farms built outside the protective glass domes
explain: Green buildings bring nature to the city with rooftop gardens, flowers and natural light, plus solar panels and water and energy-saving systems.

q: What could you find inside one 'City in a Building' skyscraper?
options: Apartments, offices, malls, gyms and cinemas in one building
Artificial forests, lakes and waterfalls in one building
Only apartments, with every shop located far away
Spacecraft landing pads and control towers in one building
explain: Hundreds of floors hold apartments, offices, malls, gyms and cinemas, so people can live, work and relax in one building. That reduces travel and saves land.

q: Which energy sources does the Central AI Brain safely monitor?
options: Solar, geothermal, coal and hydrogen energy sources
Nuclear, solar, wind and tidal energy sources
Wind, biofuel, diesel and tidal energy sources
Coal, oil, gas and wood as the main energy sources
explain: The Central AI Brain monitors nuclear, solar, wind and tidal energy, optimizes the grid to prevent blackouts, and stores extra power to eliminate waste.

q: How does AI keep Nova City's roads free of traffic jams?
options: Human traffic officers stationed at every junction
Fixed speed limits of 20 km/h on every road
Smart traffic signals that adjust in real time
A ban on all vehicles during the busiest hours
explain: Smart signals adjust in real time to eliminate traffic jams, while driverless buses and taxis offer fast, safe public travel.

q: What can connected health devices do in Nova City?
options: They monitor health and automatically send medical help
They send all health data to Earth once every year
They replace every doctor and hospital in the city
They guarantee that nobody will ever become sick
explain: Connected devices continuously monitor personal health and automatically dispatch medical assistance when needed.
